title: "Shared Part II supplied-trial memory and execution time"
format: html
---

Issue [#368](https://github.com/tannerpolley/Amine-Thermodynamics/issues/368)
changes when supplied trials are constructed. It does not change the
thermodynamic model, search tolerances, supplied compositions or parameter
adoption. The comparison base is `1cb771e`.

## Ownership and replacement

`Route.grid()` supplies one shared inventory to `stable_refit_255.grid()`.
The state worker constructs native phases as it evaluates that state. The
removed dictionary copied every trial for every state before starting any
worker. Existing state-specific inventories remain supported for Part I.

Within a state, equal kind, ordered support, full composition and packing
identify the same input. No rounding or tolerance enters that comparison.
Repeated inputs share an Engine evaluation; expansion to the original order
preserves the recorded counts and classifications. Witness accumulation
still happens after the search, so earlier states do not change later states'
input inventories during that search.

## Measured MDEA slice

This is a computational feasibility measurement, not physical validation.
The wheel is Engine `391dfe5d64ede5036bf160bc6ae037ad5e14af32`, SHA-256
`0962e21d2fa7a8ba1ed4622f1110b3e8053bacd878fa41c999d85e8b9afab66b`.
`Route.verify()` compared installed Engine files with the pinned wheel.

The #343 Stage B preparation declaration supplied 67 stocks, 56 loading
nodes, nine temperatures (313.15–393.15 K) and both bubble-pressure multipliers
(1.05 and 3.0). This gives 67,536 grid states plus 1,563 data states.
The unoptimized first declared start was bound to the already adopted shared
F2 values. No fit or new adoption was performed.

The frozen provisional inventory is `/tmp/issue368/provisional-registry.json`,
SHA-256 `985a1e64fb443620770460466bbe96ba4b98eadc0b3175be517dea50a0b40af1`.
It was copied from #343's `/tmp/issue343-mdea-registry/candidate-registry.json`:
2,789 records, eight species in the declaration order. Each record's named
support was converted to indices in that order, `packing_fraction` to
`packing`, and `liquid` to `Liquid`. Compositions were unchanged. This remains
provisional evidence, not an adopted split record. #343 owns its corrections.
The exact transformed measurement inventory is retained in
[provisional-trials.json.gz](results/provisional-trials.json.gz).

Both runs used `agent-heavy /usr/bin/time -v uv run --no-sync python
/tmp/issue368/bench.py N`. The script timed `Route.grid()` and each native
`eq.stability_test()` call; it counted returned trials with `evidence ==
'evaluated'`. Native timing excludes parent solution, optimized search,
process initialization, output writing and Python trial construction.

| Measurement | First slice | Broader slice |
|---|---:|---:|
| States | 1 | 15 |
| `Route.grid()` elapsed time, s | 4.7413 | 26.9123 |
| Maximum resident set, KiB | 267,460 | 474,032 |
| Supplied trials evaluated | 2,789 | 39,046 |
| Supplied trials unavailable | 0 | 2,789 |
| Supplied trials not applicable | 0 | 0 |

The broader slice selected 12 equally spaced indices across the declared grid,
including both ends, and data-state indices 0, 781 and 1562. Exact keys,
classifications and timing records are retained in
[the slice result](results/bench-12.json), [native timings](results/native-12.jsonl)
and [time output](results/bench-12.log.gz). Thirteen state searches were available;
one state had a supplied-parent failure, and another had an unavailable
optimized search while all supplied trials were evaluated. One state showed
descent. These counts do not establish the full-grid split count.

`/usr/bin/time -v` reports maximum process resident memory, not the simultaneous
sum of parent and workers. The measured 463 MiB maximum therefore does not
certify an aggregate memory bound for a full campaign. Input trial copies no
longer grow with grid size. Retained result records still grow with the number
of states and trials; the slice does not qualify keeping the full MDEA result
in memory. Never launch the full campaign based solely on this measurement.

## Wall-time projection

The 14 completed native calls each evaluated 2,789 trials. Their pooled mean
was **1.15872 ms per supplied-trial evaluation**, with call-average values
between **1.06335 and 1.24579 ms**. These are elapsed times under concurrent
execution on a busy shared machine, not isolated CPU costs or a statistical
confidence interval. There was one measurement run at each slice size.

The requested three-core projection uses observed complete-slice throughput:
26.9123 s / 15 states × 69,099 states = **34.44 hours per complete search**.
The 67,536 grid states already include both pressure multipliers; they must
not be doubled again. With 2,789 inputs per state, nominal full coverage is
192,717,111 supplied inputs. The native-only ideal division by three gives
20.68 hours, excluding the costs listed above, and is not the end-to-end
projection. Exact retained arithmetic is in [projection.json](results/projection.json).

The slice's failures, chunk scheduling and initialization influence the
34.44-hour projection. Different stocks, parameters, corrections to the split
record, new witnesses, parent failures and optimized searches can change it.
No campaign runtime or full-grid peak memory was measured. The result supports
planning a search that takes approximately a day or longer, subject to the
remaining result-memory limitation; it does not support claiming the full
campaign is ready to run safely.

## Numerical identity checks

The comparison executes the `1cb771e` and changed implementations against the
same installed pinned wheel, removes only `seconds` fields, and compares
complete result structures. The [retained verification report](results/verification.json) records the
caller identities and exact suite failure sets. The final focused suite has
18 passes; the new lazy-construction test fails against the base. The changed
full suite has 113 passes and 11 failures; the baseline has 112 passes and
the same 11 named failures. Six MEA F2 states compare exactly, covering both
pressure multipliers at the selected grid indices 0, 1, 900, 901, 1798 and 1799.
The duplicate check observes one native evaluation for two equal AMP loaded
inputs and two equal retained output records. PZ rows 55 and 56, including both repeated searches and all 102 supplied
trials per search, match exactly. AMP binary, loaded and deliberately failed
optimized-search outputs match exactly, including support differences and
not-applicable counts. The full DEA start-0 search matches exactly: 3,791
states, 3,736 available, 55 unavailable and zero splits. Complete compared
values are retained in [caller-results.json.gz](results/caller-results.json.gz)
and [mea-F2-results.json.gz](results/mea-F2-results.json.gz).
These checks verify preserved
calculations; they do not validate the physical model.

Independent delivered review remains a gate before merge. This notebook is
not promoted for manuscript use. It is retained without site registration
because this task prohibits changing `analyses/_cse-manuscript.json`.
